provenance: Intent descriptions copied verbatim from ga Tests/Common/GA.Business.ML.Tests/Eval/RoutingEvalHarness.cs BuildIntentRegistry (text authored 2026-05-10 at ga db702ce9, before the held-out TEST was authored 2026-06-13). __none__ was written for this experiment without reading TEST prompts.
instructions: Which assistant skill should handle this user message? Choose __none__ if the message is not a request that one of the listed guitar and music-theory skills can answer.

criteria.skill.scaleinfo: Scale info — notes of a named scale.
criteria.skill.modes: Modes of the major scale — list and discuss.
criteria.skill.interval: Interval between two notes / interval naming.
criteria.skill.chordsubstitution: Chord substitution suggestions for a given chord.
criteria.skill.progressionmood: Darken or brighten a chord progression via parallel-minor swaps, modal interchange, or borrowed chords.
criteria.skill.genreessentials: Essential chords / scales for a genre.
criteria.skill.whatcanyoudo: Meta — what the assistant can do.
criteria.skill.transpose: Transpose a chord or progression by an interval.
criteria.skill.keyidentification: Identify the key of a chord progression.
criteria.skill.progressioncompletion: Suggest the next chord in a progression.
criteria.__none__: None of these skills: the message is off-topic, not about guitar or music theory, or asks for something no listed skill does.
